description: This file implements a command-line interface command for connecting to a gateway, parsing command-line arguments, managing connection options, and outputting connection status and information. It defines structures and functions to handle connection options, perform the connection asynchronously, and display results in either JSON or plain text.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: Represents the command-line options for the connect command, including parsing logic.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: Encapsulates the data to be outputted after attempting a connection, including status, url, mode, role, scopes, snapshot, health, and error.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor that safely stores and retrieves the latest HelloOk snapshot.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: Represents the resolved URL, token, password, and mode for establishing a gateway connection.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for gateway connection, such as URLs, tokens, ports, and bind addresses.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a ConnectOptions instance.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Main function that executes the connect command asynchronously, managing connection setup and output.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Outputs the connection result in either JSON or human-readable text.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the gateway endpoint URL, token, and password based on options and configuration.
